abstract: The radiosensitivity of murine teratocarcinoma cells was investigated. Our findings are as follows: (1) the undifferentiated teratocarcinoma cells are 3 times more sensitive to UV than their differentiated counterpart and BALB/3T3 cells; (2) X-ray sensitivity of the undifferentiated cells is comparable to that of BALB/3T3 cells; (3) post-irradiation treatment with caffeine strongly sensitizes a fraction of the undifferentiated cells to UV and X-rays resulting in biphasic survival curves of the cells; (4) high UV sensitivity and hyper-sensitization by caffeine is lost upon differentiation of the cells. Possible mechanisms for the unusually high sensitivity of undifferentiated teratocarcinoma cells to radiation and post-irradiation treatment with caffeine will be discussed.
abstract_ja: 未分化マウス奇形癌細胞の放射線感受性を調べた。主な所見は次のとおりである。（1）未分化奇形癌細胞は、分化した対応細胞およびBALB/3T3細胞と比べてUVに約3倍感受性が高い。（2）未分化細胞のX線感受性はBALB/3T3細胞と同等である。（3）照射後のカフェイン処理により未分化細胞の一部が強く感作され、二相性の生存曲線が生じる。（4）高いUV感受性とカフェインによる感作は、細胞の分化により失われる。未分化奇形癌細胞が放射線およびカフェイン照射後処理に対して異常に高い感受性を示す機序について考察する。
